data.name: Verify release UI and ad contract
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR" grep -q '呑み処アーケード' nomikai-arcade.html grep -q '

呑み処アーケード

' nomikai-arcade.html grep -q '
' nomikai-arcade.html if grep -q '〆にどうぞ' nomikai-arcade.html; then echo 'FAIL: removed closing copy is still present in source HTML' exit 1 fi grep -q 'import GoogleMobileAds' NomikaiArcadeApp.swift grep -q 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/3986624511' NomikaiArcadeApp.swift grep -q "document.querySelector('.site-title')" NomikaiArcadeApp.swift grep -q '今夜のおすすめ ・ PR' NomikaiArcadeApp.swift echo 'PASS: home-only izakaya native-ad contract is present.'

data.name: Set Build 7 and generated Info.plist ad keys
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('NomikaiArcade.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj')
text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old = 'CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = 1;'
count = text.count(old)
if count != 2:
    raise SystemExit(f'Expected two project build-number entries, found {count}')
text = text.replace(old, 'CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = 7;')
anchor = 'INFOPLIST_KEY_CFBundleDisplayName = "呑み処アーケード";'
if text.count(anchor) != 2:
    raise SystemExit('Expected two CFBundleDisplayName anchors')
replacement = anchor + '\n\t\t\t\tINFOPLIST_KEY_GADApplicationIdentifier = "ca-app-pub-3940256099942544~1458002511";\n\t\t\t\tINFOPLIST_KEY_ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO;'
text = text.replace(anchor, replacement)
p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
print('PASS: Build 7 + test AdMob app id + export compliance keys set')
PY

data.name: Verify signed IPA contract
data.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash cd "$CM_BUILD_DIR" IPA="$(find build/ios/ipa -name '*.ipa' -type f | head -1)" test -n "$IPA" -a -f "$IPA" rm -rf /tmp/nomikai-ipa-check mkdir -p /tmp/nomikai-ipa-check unzip -q "$IPA" -d /tmp/nomikai-ipa-check APP="$(find /tmp/nomikai-ipa-check/Payload -maxdepth 1 -name '*.app' -type d | head -1)" test -n "$APP" -a -d "$APP" HTML="$APP/nomikai-arcade.html" test -f "$HTML" grep -q '

呑み処アーケード

' "$HTML" grep -q '
' "$HTML" if grep -q '〆にどうぞ' "$HTML"; then echo 'FAIL: removed closing copy is still present in signed IPA' exit 1 fi PLIST="$APP/Info.plist" /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :GADApplicationIdentifier' "$PLIST" | grep -q 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544~1458002511' /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption' "$PLIST" | grep -q 'false' echo 'PASS: signed IPA contains corrected UI and AdMob/TestFlight metadata.'
